name: Prescribing: drug resolution, dose recomputation, interactions and allergies
description: A drug a model reads is resolved to a code, its dose is recomputed in code from the patient's weight, age and kidney function, and interactions and allergies are looked up, all against licensed reference data.
limits: Ships no reference data: the bundled formulary is a fixture with made-up codes and simplified rules, for tests only. Real drug, dosing, interaction and allergy-class data must be licensed and confirmed before loading. Cockcroft-Gault is one estimate of kidney function among several. Not reviewed by the clinical safety lead.

hazards.title: A wrong drug or dose reaches a prescriber's screen
A dangerous interaction or allergy is missed

controls.title: Drug resolved to a standard code
controls.requirement: Each drug a model reads resolves to exactly one code in the licensed reference data, by exact name or listed synonym.

controls.title: Dose recomputed in code
controls.requirement: The dose is recomputed in code from weight, age and kidney function, and a proposed dose that differs, or a contraindication, is caught.

controls.title: Interactions looked up
controls.requirement: No major or contraindicated interaction with a current medication; an unknown medication fails safe.

controls.title: Allergies looked up
controls.requirement: The drug is not, and is not in the class of, a recorded allergy; an unknown allergy fails safe.

controls.title: Reference data licensing confirmed
controls.requirement: Reference data is loaded only once its licence is confirmed and recorded; fixtures are marked as fixtures.
